newsitem.title: USA: Edgerton Musical sets production startup.
newsitem.headline: Edgerton Musical sets production startup.

text.p: Edgerton Musical Amplifiers Inc said Wednesday it moved into its new manufacturing facility in Olathe, Kan., and is preparing to begin production of speaker cabinets, which are a required part of the Edgerton combo amplifiers.
The company will use automated production equipment.
A spokeswoman for the musical instrument company told Reuters product deliveries from the new plant are expected in the second quarter.
